R20 floor: scoreRatePerSecond x v is added every frame (P35 L7515-7522, L7614-7621, Sleep(0) loop). The DE VM adds in float32: a per-frame gain below half a float32 step of the score never changes it. Near the map goal (1450: scores 1024-2048, half step 2^-14) one tower at rate 1 stalls when v x dt < 6.1e-5: at 0.05 above 819 fps, at 0.1 above 1638 fps (goals up to 2048). The round can then never end. 0.1 = rounds of at least about 30 min. readable decompile 44.0.2 (work/research/mission-owners-2026-09-30/decomp unless noted)
